newsitem.title: GERMANY: German roasters ready to sit out coffee rallies.
newsitem.headline: German roasters ready to sit out coffee rallies.

text.p: The German coffee industry can afford to sit back amid volatile futures because arabica cover for the summer months appears to be intact, traders said on Monday.
"Roasters are preoccupied with attempts to boost internal retail prices and are not prepared to move as long as futures are so volatile," one said.
But he added, "This is not to say that supply in the second half of 1997 is comfortable...they are just taking a breather."
New York's arabica market last week rallied ahead of Brazil's frost season.
It gained as much as 16 percent on concern over Latin American supply and low consumer stocks before pulling back in a technical correction.
Origin sellers were trying to place nearby arabicas to take advantage of historically high levels but they met only scant interest in Germany.
Traders said offers of Brazilian unwashed arabicas (medium to good beans) for some European destinations were plentiful up to June but they do not qualify for most German blends.
The picture in the second half looked far tighter.
"Although there is no current buying interest, either traders or roasters are still quite short from July onwards," one trader said.
German roasters are planning further retail price rises in response to arabica futures advances.
Market leader Kraft Jacobs Suchard (KJS) said it would probably announce price increases later this week and most competitors tend to follow KJS.
The German number two, Tchibo, last Friday added up to one mark per 0.5 kg to the price of its high quality coffee on sale in its 20,000 shops.
In the import markets, Kenyans jumped $35 on the week to $385 per 50 kg fob, having gained $48 in the previous week.
This was prohibitively high, compared with Brazils at $226 and Colombia Excelso at $280, all for May/June.
Vietnam G-2 robustas were up $3 at $75, cif basis.
Traders noted steady roaster and trade buying demand for Vietnamese and Indonesian material.
